session_1_memories.text: The checkout race was caused by concurrent stock decrements without locking.
The fix uses a Redis distributed lock around the stock decrement.
Load testing measured a 50ms p99 latency improvement after the checkout fix.
ACME Corp has enterprise custom SSO configured.
Follow-up: add lock contention monitoring and backport the checkout fix to v2.x.
Conference badges will be printed on Monday.
The team ordered fruit for the afternoon break.
The meeting-room wallpaper sample is gray.
Visitor parking permits expire at six o'clock.

session_1_summary: The checkout cause was concurrent stock decrements without locking; the fix is a Redis distributed lock around the stock decrement. It delivered a 50ms p99 latency improvement. ACME Corp uses enterprise custom SSO.
